summary.yieldDenominator: All requested Monte Carlo trials, including invalid physical/ray trials

coverage.aperturePolicy: Retained Optiwork existing aperture semantics; imported NONE display apertures are not asserted to be physical factory apertures.

execution.tracePath: Existing exact float64 dispatcher with unchanged native fallback
execution.trialOrdering: Original row/endpoint and Monte Carlo trial-index order, independent of scheduling
execution.randomGenerator: Independent PCG64 SeedSequence(rootSeed, spawn_key=(trialIndex-1,)) per trial

definitions.normalParameters: mean/sigma are the underlying untruncated Gaussian parameters; defaults0 and(max-min)/6 are editable engineering choices
definitions.surfaceRange: Inclusive LDE1..N-2, including AIR planes; start=end is valid. Excluded configured rows are retained.
definitions.worstWavefrontRmsWaves: Worst active field/color RMS OPD after monochromatic piston and tilt removal; defocus retained
definitions.rmsSpotUm: Field-weighted RMS of polychromatic centroid-referenced geometric RMS spot with every original spectral/pupil weight
definitions.eflMm: Primary-wavelength paraxial EFL for centered studies, using perturbed glass indices for material errors
definitions.compensation: One bounded common AIR-spacing adjustment per whole trial; prescribed image gap is unchanged for surface_spacing
definitions.statistics: Valid-trial metrics only; every requested failed trial remains in the yield denominator. No acceptance limits are invented.
definitions.spectralReuse: Only exactly equal wavelength and full refractive-index vectors share a trace; original group indices/weights remain reported
definitions.projectFingerprint: Canonical validated project with configuration, excluding runtime caches and sealed catalog locations; material groups, coefficients and proof hashes retained; catalog identity separate
definitions.scope: Sequential refractive material, fabrication and alignment tolerances. Physical analysis covers the selected optical error rows.
definitions.alignment: Fixed entrance launch with respect to pose errors; local vertex pivot for one surface or first vertex for a rigid group. Image plane remains fixed unless compensated.
definitions.dispersion: Scale the catalog dispersion about d to satisfy perturbed nd and Vd where d/F/C data exist; otherwise apply an index offset only.

warnings: Sampling convergence and manufacturing yield are not certified; limits/presets are editable engineering choices.

Existing saved-aperture and imported-aperture trace semantics are retained, with explicit clipping preserved. An imported NONE display aperture is not verified factory-aperture evidence; failures and engineering pass fractions are not factory yield.
